-- Spec for checked addition. The helper states the int64 range in bigint terms.
fits_int(n: bigint) -> bool =
  ex fits_int(bigint(5)) == True
  ex fits_int(bigint(9223372036854775807) + bigint(1)) == False
  n >= bigint(-9223372036854775808) and n <= bigint(9223372036854775807)

checked_add(a: int, b: int) -> int? =
  post out == None or out == a + b
  post (out == None) == (fits_int(bigint(a) + bigint(b)) == False)
  ex checked_add(1, 2) == 3
  ex checked_add(9223372036854775807, 1) == None
  ex checked_add(-9223372036854775808, -1) == None
  let s = bigint(a) + bigint(b)
  if fits_int(s)
    return a + b
  None
